## sb-ibd

Gegevensset voor volwassen patiënten met inflammatoire darmziekten (IBD): verrichtingen (waaronder scopieën), calprotectinemetingen en de Luscii PREMs.

Version 0.1.0 · definition [sb-ibd](Binary-sb-ibd.html) · [Group](Group-sb-ibd-cohort.html) · [Parameters](Parameters-sb-ibd-export.html) · profiles [Procedure](StructureDefinition-sb-ibd-procedure.html), [Observation](StructureDefinition-sb-ibd-observation.html), [QuestionnaireResponse](StructureDefinition-sb-ibd-questionnaireresponse.html), [Patient](StructureDefinition-sb-ibd-patient.html)

### Group

**IBD bij volwassenen** (HIX: cohort_sb-ibd_dbc.sql). Alle patiënten van 18 jaar of ouder op het moment van
aanleveren met een geldige DOT (niet vervallen) met zorgtype 11 of 21, geopend op of na 01-01-2018, en:

- 0313 Interne Geneeskunde met diagnose 922 of 923 (internist met specialisatie maag-darm-leverziekten); of
- 0318 Maag-Darm-Leverziekten met diagnose 601 of 602.

De startdatum 01-01-2018 is bewust niet dynamisch.

**Nog niet in deze definitie** (staat wel in de cohortbeschrijving van de query):

- *IBD bij kinderen*: een Paris-classificatie (Crohn of CU) op of na 01-01-2020 én een DOT 0316
  Kindergeneeskunde met diagnose 3303, 3308, 3311, 3314, 3315 of 3399, zonder leeftijdsgrens. Dit is een
  tweede, alternatieve tak (OF); een Group met member-filters kent alleen EN.
- *ZBJ_IBD*: patiënten met een CarePlan-categorie ZBJ_IBD gestart op of na 01-01-2018 (alleen in de
  toelichting van de query, niet in de SQL zelf).

A patient is in the Group when **all** filters apply.

| Resource | Field | Parameter | Condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Patient** | `birthDate` | `birthdate` | 18 years or older at delivery |
| **EpisodeOfCare** | `type` | `type` | NZa zorgtype 11, 21 |
|  | `status` | `status` | active (open), finished (closed) |
|  | `period` | `date` | ≥ 2018-01-01 |
|  | `diagnosis.condition.code` | `diagnosis:Condition.code` | specialisme-diagnose 0313\|922, 0313\|923, 0318\|601, 0318\|602 |

Checked after selection:

- De DOT moet op of na 01-01-2018 geopend zijn. Een FHIR-datumzoekactie op EpisodeOfCare.period (`date=ge2018-01-01`) selecteert elke DOT die 2018 of later overlapt, dus ook een DOT die eerder begon; de begindatum wordt daarom na de query gecontroleerd.

### Export

The fields requested for the patients in the Group; a field with a filter shows its search parameter and condition. Requests that differ only in their codes are merged (**or**). Every record also carries a hashed `identifier`.

| Resource | Field | Parameter | Condition | Needed for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Procedure** | `code` | `code:in` | [Verrichting Type Codes NZa (Scopie)](ValueSet-local-verrichting-codes-nza.html) (4 codes) **or** [Verrichting Type Codes NZa (sb-ibd)](ValueSet-ibd-verrichting-codes-nza.html) (73 codes) | [K3.1.2 Scopie](Binary-k312-scopie.html), [K3.6.3 Calprotectine voor scopie](Binary-k363-calprotectin-before-scopie.html), the dataset itself |
|  | `performed[x]` | `date` | ≥ 2018-01-01 |  |
|  | `subject` |  |  |  |
| **Observation** | `code` | `code` | Calprotectine (feces) (LOINC 38445-3) | [K3.6.3 Calprotectine voor scopie](Binary-k363-calprotectin-before-scopie.html) |
|  | `value[x]` |  |  |  |
|  | `effective[x]` | `date` | ≥ 2018-01-01 |  |
|  | `subject` |  |  |  |
| **QuestionnaireResponse** | `questionnaire` | `questionnaire` | [Luscii_PREMs](Questionnaire-2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.3.11.60.124.27.62--20250714064425.html) | [Luscii PREMs](Binary-luscii-prems.html) |
|  | `authored` | `authored` | ≥ 2018-01-01 |  |
|  | `item` |  |  |  |
|  | `subject` |  |  |  |
| **Patient** | `gender` | `gender` | male, female | the dataset itself |
|  | `birthDate` |  |  |  |

Calculated after delivery:

- **[K3.6.3 Calprotectine voor scopie](Binary-k363-calprotectin-before-scopie.html)**: A calprotectin measurement counts only when it falls within the 90 days up to and including the start of a scopie of the same patient. A date relation between two resources cannot be expressed in a FHIR search.

### Query

Executed in this order; `$export` is asynchronous, so poll each status location until it completes. Date placeholders such as `{today-18y}` are filled in when the request is sent. Every filter and element must be covered by the [de-identification](deidentification.html#core-principles) ruleset. Long values are wrapped for reading: a line starting with `&` continues the filter above it.

```text
PUT [base]/Group/sb-ibd-cohort
  member-filter (all must match):
    Patient?birthdate=le{today-18y}
    EpisodeOfCare?type=https://declaratie.nza.nl/zorgtype|11,https://declaratie.nza.nl/zorgtype|21
                 &status=active,finished
                 &date=ge2018-01-01
                 &diagnosis:Condition.code=https://ig.santeon.nl/CodeSystem/specialisme-diagnose|0313\|922,https://ig.santeon.nl/CodeSystem/specialisme-diagnose|0313\|923,https://ig.santeon.nl/CodeSystem/specialisme-diagnose|0318\|601,https://ig.santeon.nl/CodeSystem/specialisme-diagnose|0318\|602

POST [base]/Group/sb-ibd-cohort/$export
  Prefer: respond-async

  _type       = Procedure,Observation,QuestionnaireResponse,Patient

  _typeFilter = Procedure?code:in=https://ig.santeon.nl/sim-on-fhir/ValueSet/local-verrichting-codes-nza,https://ig.santeon.nl/sim-on-fhir/ValueSet/ibd-verrichting-codes-nza
                         &date=ge2018-01-01
  _typeFilter = Observation?code=http://loinc.org|38445-3
                           &date=ge2018-01-01
  _typeFilter = QuestionnaireResponse?questionnaire=http://decor.nictiz.nl/fhir/Questionnaire/2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.3.11.60.124.27.62--20250714064425
                                     &authored=ge2018-01-01
  _typeFilter = Patient?gender=male,female

  _elements   = Procedure.identifier,Procedure.code,Procedure.performed[x],Procedure.subject,
                Observation.identifier,Observation.code,Observation.value[x],Observation.effective[x],Observation.subject,
                QuestionnaireResponse.identifier,QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire,QuestionnaireResponse.authored,QuestionnaireResponse.item,QuestionnaireResponse.subject,
                Patient.identifier,Patient.gender,Patient.birthDate
```
